items.title: M 7.3 - 24 km WNW of Port-Vila, Vanuatu

The Democratic Republic of the Congo's Health Ministry announces that the mystery illness that has left at least 143 people dead in Kwango was a severe form of malaria. The World Health Organization says more malaria vaccines are being sent to its health centres in the region.
Turkey reports a record 243 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 17,364.
South Korea reports a record 22 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 634.
Alberta reports a record 30 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the provincial death toll to 790.

American-led airstrikes kill at least 180 Islamic State fighters while local Kurdish forces repel an assault by 300 heavily armed militants in northern Iraq.
Pakistan lifts the moratorium on the death penalty for terror-related cases following the Taliban's assault on a school in Peshawar on Tuesday that killed 141, including 132 children.
Flash floods triggered by Tropical Storm Washi kill at least 400 people in the Philippines with hundreds more missing.
